description: Exports the finished video and returns a download link; with save_to it also saves it to that path on this machine. Use it only when the current user request asks to deliver, download, export, or publish the video; READY only means exporting is possible and does not authorize it. **Exporting changes nothing and can be repeated safely.** It waits up to timeout_s (max 35), otherwise returns pending=true — not a failure: track action.operation.id with huasheng_wait_for_action; do not call this write again. save_to saves in the background (saving_to), tracked the same way. task_id resumes a known export.

pid.description: Video id (15 digits); default: this machine's current video.

save_to.description: Local path to save to, e.g. ./out.mp4; omit for a link only

task_id.description: Existing export task to resume instead of exporting again
